name: Band Good Morning
steps: Stand on one end of a heavy resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and loop the other end comfortably behind your upper back.
Keep a slight fixed bend in your knees, brace your core, and hold the band lightly near your shoulders.
Push your hips smoothly backward while hinging forward with a flat back until your torso nears parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forcefully forward against the band to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at lockout.
tips: Place the band across your upper traps rather than directly on the bones of your neck.
Maintain a flat neutral spine throughout the hinge and stop lowering before your lower back rounds.
